consult.title: Ask the clinic
consult.description: Write a general question. The answer is educational and does not replace an exam.
consult.note1: Answers are educational and do not replace an examination.
consult.note2: Do not enter identity details such as a national ID.
consult.note3: For a visit, use the booking page.
consult.emergencyBody: For heavy bleeding, fast swelling of the face or neck, trouble breathing, or trouble swallowing, call 115 or go to the nearest emergency department.
consult.disclaimer: The desk can be wrong. For a treatment decision, talk with the surgeon.
consult.fallback: This is better asked at the exam. For a time, open the booking page.
consult.greeting: Hello. Ask about treatment, care after surgery, or booking.
consult.a1: The surgery is done under local anaesthetic, so you do not feel pain during it. Afterwards there may be a few days of discomfort and swelling, managed with the prescribed medicine and a cold compress.
consult.q2: How long does implant treatment take?
consult.a2: From surgery to the crown it usually takes two to six months. A bone graft or sinus lift makes it longer. The exact timing is set at the exam.
consult.q3: Do all wisdom teeth have to be removed?
consult.a3: No. A wisdom tooth that is healthy, fully erupted, and possible to clean can stay. The decision uses symptoms, the radiograph, and the risk to the neighbouring tooth.
consult.q4: What should I do in the first 24 hours after an extraction?
consult.a4: Hold gauze with gentle pressure, do not spit, and do not use a straw. Eat soft food and place a cold compress on the cheek in short turns. If heavy bleeding continues, call the same day.
